findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection, the bleach bucket was recorded at 10ppm chlorine. This bucket was dumped and remade and tested at 100ppm. Ensure testing is completed at a freqeuncy necessary to maintain sanitizer concentration.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Both the walk-in freezers were observed to have ice accumulation around the pipe where insulation has degraded. Ensure the old insulation is removed and new insulation is placed around the piping to prevent the accumulation of ice.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The walk-in freezer is observed to have an accumulation of ice on the ceiling. This ice accumulation will need to be removed from the ceiling during times when no contamination of food products in the freezer takes place. If food products are present in the freezer, a tray or other form of covering should be placed over the items to protect them while cleaning. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12 Food employee was observed shutting off the manual faucet without a barrier and touching the handle of paper towel dispenser to finish dispensing paper towels to dry hands after faucet was shut off. Proper technique was discussed. Food employee was observed washing hands properly the remainder of inspection and used her forearm and paper towels as barriers to avoid re-contaminaton of washed hands. 
Food employees shall properly wash their hands with the following procedure: (1) rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) apply soap; (3) rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds; (4) thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying. 
To avoid recontaminating hands, use a disposable paper towel or similar clean barrier when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a handwashing sink.

findings.title: Pre-flushed, scraped, soaked
findings.comment:
750.830f - Food debris was observed on a mixing wand attachment in the clean utensil drawer. The wand had been through ware washing process and placed back in the drawer for storage with other utensils. Mixing wand was given to staff member in dish area so it could go through proper ware washing process.
Equipment and utensils shall be pre-flushed or pre-scraped and, when necessary, pre-soaked to remove gross food particles and soil prior to their being cleaned in a dishwashing machine unless a pre-wash cycle is a part of the dishwashing machine operation. **The process needs to be repeated as many times as necessary to ensure all debris is removed and all surfaces are properly cleaned and sanitized.**

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Bleach solution for wiping cloths tested at less than 100ppm chlorine. Staff noted it was made this morning and needed to be emptied. Solution was discarded, and staff were to remake a solution at proper concentration of 100ppm after kitchen staff lunch break/prior to lunch service.
Maintain bleach solution at 100ppm. Change solutions ever 2 to 4 hrs or more often if solutions and wiping cloths become heavily soiled. Frequent use will require more frequent changes of solution. Maintain a bleach solution at all times to allow for wiping of surfaces throughout daily operations. Also, maintain separate solutions for non-food contact surfaces and food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
A 108 oz. can of kidney beans was dented on the top seam.  The can was set aside to return to the vender.  Cans of potentially hazardous food should not be dented on the top, bottom, or vertical seam.

750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Several squirt bottles of Ketchup were unlabeled after transferring the ketchup from the original container.  Labels were put on the squirt bottles identifying the contents to CORRECT the violation.

750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Students' food trays were stored food side up on the service line.  Cover the trays, invert them, or invert the top tray until ready to serve food.

750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor below the wire milk shelf in the walk-in cooler was soiled.  Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(A) The caulk seal between the tray and wall to the right of the garbage disposal on the dish wasing line was moldy.  Remove the caulk, sanitize the area to kill the mold, and reseal the gap.               (B) The tiles in the bathrooms are acoustic tiles.  On or before the next remodel of the facilities, replace the tiles with ones that are smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Cleaning chemicals were stored above the exit end of the dish machine tray.  The chemicals were moved to a bottom shelf to minimize the potential for contamination of food equipment surfaces.

750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
A can of salsa was dented on the top seam.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.
The can was discarded to CORRECT the violation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - Plastic trim inside warmer (kitchen side) was pulling away at the top and had a crack on the bottom. Repair the plastic trim inside the warmer so it is not pulling away from the equipment at the top and the crack on the bottom is sealed. New trim has been received to make necessary repairs but has not yet been installed. Replace the damaged trim in the warmer by the next routine inspection. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Bucket of sanitizer solution was not made up, and a wet cloth was being used to wipe off a prep table. The bucket had been emptied prior to inspector's arrival. Kitchen manager stated the rag had been in the solution prior to emptying the bucket. The moisture left behind on the prep table after it was wiped off tested at 0ppm chlorine. Maintain a bucket of sanitizer solution (100ppm) at all times for sanitizing general surfaces and storage of wet wiping cloths between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) can opener blade (food debris) & B) floor fan in dish area (dust on blades). Properly clean and sanitize all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. Run the can opener thru the dish machine once cans have been opened and/or set the opener in the dirty dish area so there is no confusion as to whether or not staff is aware it needs to be cleaned/sanitized.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Gaps were observed where the door frame meets the floor at both outer doors in the kitchen. Four ants were observed around the door frame closest to the walkin cooler. B) Gaps were observed along the floor to wall joint along the outside of the walkin units and behind the ice machine. Properly seal the floor to wall joint and where the door frames meet the floor in the above areas. C) The floor along the door inside the large walkin freezer was soiled with debris & dead bugs. Clean the floor inside the large walkin freezer in this area.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Small roll cart in walkin cooler was observed to be rusty/rough. Clean and resurface the cart. B) Plastic trim inside warmer (kitchen side) was pulling away at the top and had a crack on the bottom. Repair the plastic trim inside the warmer so it is not pulling away from the equipment at the top and the crack on the bottom is sealed.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - A) An old glue strip w/ dead bugs on it was observed in the dry storage room (by garbage can lid/extra shelves). B) Significant number of dead bugs were observe on the floor in the walkin freezer at the threshold and by the walls nearest the door. Floors throughout must be kept clean. Discard old glue traps, and clean the floors throughout daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of dead bugs and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed debris in the bottom of a tub containing clean utensils.  Clean and sanitize the tub and maintain clean.
